files.description: The original payment: one case line and two other claims.
The adjusted check: the reversal and correction of the case line and two unrelated claims.
A posting export with one check-level row for part of the check, no line detail.
The original payment of two case lines: 97110 x 2 on 2026-03-09 and on 2026-03-10, each allowed 70.00.
The adjusted remittance paid by check 880060090004: both lines allowed 100.00.
A posting export with line detail: one row posting the corrected claim’s 2026-03-09 line, none for the 2026-03-10 line.

scenario.packet: submitted for the 97110 line before the adjusted remittance arrives

outcome.allocation: the case share times the posted amount over the check total, flagged allocated

lines.stage: recovered at the posted proof level

lineLevel.note: a row with line detail posts only the line it posts; the other line waits for its own row
